༄༅/ /phyag drug pa'i bsang mchod bstan pa 'phel byed zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag drug pa'i bsang mchod bstan pa 'phel byed zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bsang rdzas rnams tshogs par byas la/ mgon po spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūṃ/ shar lhor dur khrod chen po nas/ /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i zhing khams su/ /tsandan shing gi rtse mo na/ /byin rlabs mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ /yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs dang*/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /e hya hi arghaṃ swā hā/ ka ma la ya st+wam/ hūṃ/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs dang*/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang*/ /nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs dang*/ / gsang ba'i mchod pa ma lus sogs/ /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa dang*/ /sna tshogs mchod pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje 'chang nas rgyud par bcas/ /bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa la/ /mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*/ /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'di dang bar du skyabs mdzod cig /bde chen mthar lam ston mdzod cig /hūṃ/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po la/ /mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*/ /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la dang*/ gnod sbyin dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang dang = /dbang dang = /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /dbang phyug dzi na mi tra dang*/ /dbang phyug dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang dang = /dbang = /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /gshin rje trakki ra dza dang*/ /gshin rje'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang = /dbang = /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/

/ bdud mgon trakshad nag po dang*/ /bdud kyi dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la/ / mchod pa'i= /bsang = /dbang = /ye shes mgon po bka' nyan pa'i/ /'jig rten dreg pa la sogs pa/ /mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*/ /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /bstan pa srung ba'i las mdzod cig /dpal ldan lha mo la sogs pa'i/ /ma mo bye ba dung phyur la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang = /bstan pa= / tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa'i/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas la/ / mchod pa'i= /bsang = /bstan= /dbang phyug khyab 'jug la sogs pa'i/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang = /bstan= /pa sangs phur bu la sogs pa'i/ /gza' chen brgyad po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i= / bsang = /bstan= /smin drug snar ma la sogs pa'i/ /rgyu skar lha mo nyer brgyad la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang = /bstan= / gang ba bzang po nor bzang sogs/ / ded dpon chen po dgu po la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang = /bstan= yul 'khor srung ba la sogs pa'i/ /rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la/ /mchod pa'i= / bsang = / bstan= /mdog nag 'jigs shing rngam pa'i tshogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang = /bstan= /yul dang gnas dang dur khrod dang*/ /gnas pa'i dpa' bo'i dpa' mo dang*/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i= /bsang = /bstan= /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /gar 'gro gar 'dug gar gnas kyang*/ /chos dang mthun pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ /gzhi bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag dang*/ /dkar phyogs chos skyong thams cad la/ /bsang dang zhi ba dam pa 'bul/ /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ / thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ / ces dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i bsang mchod bstan pa 'phel byed 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa dge/
//sarba maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 162 -- PAGE 161 -- PAGE 160 -
